maddeler.e:
انشغلت (form VII)
# اِنْشَغَلْتُ (inšaḡaltu) /in.ʃa.ɣal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْشَغَلَ (inšaḡala)
# اِنْشَغَلْتَ (inšaḡalta) /in.ʃa.ɣal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْشَغَلَ (inšaḡala)
# اِنْشَغَلْتِ (inšaḡalti) /in.ʃa.ɣal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْشَغَلَ (inšaḡala)
# اِنْشَغَلَتْ (inšaḡalat) /in.ʃa.ɣa.lat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
